suite.name: Glen Canyon Dam to Lees Ferry global-parameter calibration

split_policy: Parameters are selected from the two 2002 training events only. The January 2004 event is validation and July 2004 is reported as a historical test. Because all four scores were inspected during model development, neither held-out split is a pristine prospective test; a future event must provide that final gate.

parameter_interpretation.manning_scale: Global multiplier on the estimated minutes-based Manning roughness.
parameter_interpretation.width_scale: Global multiplier on both estimated rectangular channel widths.
parameter_interpretation.slope_scale: Global multiplier on the estimated longitudinal bed slope.
parameter_interpretation.lateral_inflow_fraction: Effective distributed reach gain as a fraction of observed upstream flow; this is not a measured tributary hydrograph.
